reviewed_sql.complete_original_normalized_sql:
WITH idxcols AS (
  SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ci.relname,a.attnum) AS ordinal,
   ci.oid::text AS index_oid, ci.relname AS index_name, tb.oid::text AS table_oid, tb.relname AS table_name,
   a.attnum AS index_attnum, a.attname AS index_attname,
   i.indnatts, i.indnkeyatts, i.indisvalid, i.indisready, i.indislive,
   i.indkey[a.attnum-$1] AS table_attnum,
   pa.attname AS source_column, pa.atttypid::text AS source_type_oid,
   format_type(pa.atttypid,pa.atttypmod) AS source_formatted_type,
   opc.opcname AS opclass, opc.opcintype::text AS opclass_input_type_oid,
   opc.opckeytype::text AS opclass_key_type_oid,
   format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS formatted_index_type,
   a.attcollation::regcollation::text AS index_collation,
   pa.attcollation::regcollation::text AS source_collation,
   (i.indexprs IS NOT NULL) AS index_has_expressions,
   (i.indpred IS NOT NULL) AS index_has_predicate,
   to_jsonb(a) AS full_catalog_tuple,
   md5(to_jsonb(a)::text) AS full_tuple_md5
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ci ON ci.oid=i.indexrelid AND ci.relnamespace=$2::regnamespace
